v11-2026-07-06

Scorer hardening: fact-claim extraction fix, PoF/gamma calibration, lane-failure honesty, weight-sensitivity analysis

2026-07-06
scoringgroundingcalibrationtooling

Numbers inside citation link labels no longer become fact claims; the proof-of-fetch threshold and reach-gate exponent now ship with a reproducible calibration artifact; broken evaluation lanes are surfaced as lane_failed instead of masquerading as real zeros; ranking stability under scoring-weight perturbation is published.

Fact axis

  • Standalone numbers inside a [label](url) link label are subject identity, not claim values: a correct price sentence citing a product named '... (Pack of 3)' no longer generates a phantom contradicted claim (regression tests added)

Calibration

  • calibrate_pof_gamma.py: 320 verbatim positives, 320 fabricated/cross-page negatives, 120 paraphrase side-class from real sandbox snapshots; threshold 0.35 confirmed (TPR 100%, FPR 0% fabricated / 0.63% cross-page); gamma=1.5 monotonic under fabrication injection at every tested rate; artifact byte-reproducible with a fixed seed
  • analyze_weight_sensitivity.py: quality-weight convention tested with 2000 Dirichlet draws on the diagnostic partial run; 91.6% identical full ranking, top-2 stable in 100%, equal weights reproduce the baseline ranking

Lane honesty

  • report_stubs.py centralizes runner-failure stub detection; extract_unified_reports.py + build_truth_board --manifest mark agents whose runs are mostly stubs as lane_failed (Qwen3-8B partial run: 185 of 592 records were stubs)
  • Verdict pipeline plumbing: candidate miner + adjudication template (83 candidates), gold loader accepts only adjudicated *.gold.json; nothing auto-promotes

scoringgroundingbugfix

The URL registry only recognized /A/ and /wiki/ article shapes; agents citing the canonical no-namespace /content/<book>/<article> path (which the sandbox serves directly, the /A/ form 302-redirects onto it) were scored as fabricators. The registry now resolves that shape; grounding-reach numbers computed before this fix under-scored wiki citations.

  • Self-test extended (19/19) and 82 registry/grounding tests pass; discovered while scoring the Qwen3-8B partial run offline

v7-2026-07-03

Pre-experiment hardening: adversarial re-check closes 28 findings across tasks, keys and scorer

2026-07-03
methodologyscoringtasksaudit

A five-way adversarial re-check of the v2 task set ran before any experiment. It found and we fixed: 15 questions asking for products the frozen store does not stock (re-anchored to measured inventory, including a tools-to-lighting cluster correction), a vitality-ranking flaw that let popular accessories outrank the actual subject, and five scorer exploits (canonical-variant padding, slug-context padding, subject misbinding, budget-number false claims, unmatched natural sentiment phrasing). All attack regressions now fail as designed.

Stock-grounded tasks

  • Every intent's focal product verified against category enumeration; the 'tools' cluster was actually lamps in the corpus taxonomy and is now honestly a home-lighting cluster; kitchen questions target stocked goods (insulated drinkware, pressure cookers, bone china) instead of absent skillets.
  • Gaming cluster dropped a furniture category that polluted relevance with bar stools.

Scorer exploits closed

  • Reachability dedupes citations by canonical page: URL-variant padding can no longer launder fabricated links (attack now scores 0.20, was 0.67).
  • Slug-only citation context counts as failed proof-of-fetch, not skipped (padding attack now 0.17, was 1.00).
  • Fact claims bind to the cited link's product; honest reports quoting official titles no longer get contradicted (fact axis 0.89, was 0.00).
  • Natural phrasing of buyer-sentiment facts now earns completeness credit; budget mentions no longer count as price claims.

v5-2026-07-03

Decidable scoring stack v2: URL-registry reachability, rebuilt verifiers, and a statistical honesty pass

2026-07-03
methodologyscoringaudit

A five-way adversarial self-audit (~55 findings) drove a rebuild of the scoring methodology. Reachability is now closed-world set membership (zero HTTP), the scorer composition is a continuous verified gate, and every headline correlation now carries bootstrap CIs and permutation tests. The public boards remain on the v1 metric until the jury re-judge lands.

Grounding, rebuilt

  • URL registry (232k enumerated URLs: products, forum submissions, wiki articles): a citation is reachable iff its canonical form is in the corpus. Search pages, dead-port tricks, redirect laundering and off-sandbox links are all handled by construction.
  • Fixed a shipped bug that lowercased Kiwix article ids (case-sensitive server), which had been mis-scoring real Wikipedia citations as fabricated.
  • Proof-of-fetch hardened: link labels, URL slug tokens, stopwords and page chrome no longer count; requires a contiguous span match over full page text.

Scorer composition v2

  • truth = reach^gamma x quality(fact, proof-of-fetch, completeness, spec); the fabricator-cannot-top property is now a checked theorem (scripts/verify_gate_theorem.py), and gamma=1.5 has an empirical justification.
  • fact-support scores zero when a report asserts no checkable facts (silence is no longer perfect precision); completeness is saturating recall@K over an importance-ranked vital pool instead of raw catalog recall.
  • Presentation (LLM jury) is reported as a separate column and can only break ties; it is never multiplied into truth.

Statistical honesty

  • Two-level bootstrap (battles -> Bradley-Terry refit -> per-task grounding) for the Elo-vs-grounding correlations: neither board's coefficient is distinguishable from zero by permutation test; the stable evidence is the inversion pattern (top-ranked by judges, bottom on grounding), which holds rank in 70-79 percent of replicates.
  • Review-to-product attachment audited and confirmed (66x topical separation; summary ratings match attached votes), validating in-store reviews as an aligned sentiment source.

v4-2026-06-16

Closed-world redesign: decidable grounding and completeness from the sandbox DB

2026-06-16
methodologygroundingcompletenesstasks

Scoring now leans on the frozen sandbox as a closed, queryable world, so grounding and completeness are decided against the database rather than estimated, and the deep-research questions are de-specified into natural user queries.

Why it changes

  • The frozen sandbox (shopping, reddit, wiki) is DB-complete, so we know the true facts and which URLs are real; grounding and completeness become decidable, not pooled estimates.
  • This is the moat over live-web benchmarks, where the relevant set is unknown and attribution must be guessed.

New grounding gate

  • Dropped must-cite-URL recall (it barely separated honest from fabricated) for a claim-level gate: ReachRate^gamma times GroundF1@K (claim support, reachability, load-bearing precision, missing-citation penalty).
  • Dead cited URLs are now penalized instead of being silently dropped from the denominator.

Completeness and de-specified tasks

  • New completeness@K metric: exact coverage of the top-K most important DB entities, derived by SQL enumeration rather than keyword scraping.
  • Task intents rewritten from over-specified scraping specs into natural research questions; quotas and section lists moved out of the prompt and into the answer key.

Result on the redesigned tasks

  • Run end-to-end with a single self-hosted Qwen3-8B judge and zero paid API.
  • The two highest raw-quality agents are fluent fabricators and are gated out; the honest agent wins the truth-gated board and leads completeness@40.

v3-2026-06-06b

Leaderboard refreshed with the clean 3-judge jury (draws 51% -> 17%)

2026-06-06
leaderboardscoringjudge

The raw judge Elo is now from a 3-model jury (deepseek-v4-flash + qwen3-max + glm-5, thinking on, position-debiased) over all 1553 battles; the position-bias draw rate dropped from 51% to 17% and the truth-gated headline is unchanged (camel-ai #1, gpt-researcher #9).

What changed

  • Old single no-thinking judge produced 51% draws -- almost all pure position-locking (it picked slot A in both swapped passes). The 3-juror jury with thinking + an anti-position prompt cuts that to 17%, and majority vote rescues the single-juror ties.
  • Headline stays truth-gated (judge Elo x grounding gate): camel-ai #1 by real evidence; the raw judge still ranks gpt-researcher / langchain-odr top, but at 5% / 2% reachable citations the gate sinks them to #9 / #5 -- the cautionary point of the benchmark.
  • Honest note: CI widened (+-25 -> +-51) because decisive battles carry more genuine disagreement than lazy ties; more bootstrap resamples can tighten it.
v3-2026-06-06a

Real 3-judge jury: all 1,553 battles rescored, silent error-to-TIE bug fixed

2026-06-06
scoringmethodology

The leaderboard is now decided by a 3-judge PoLL jury (deepseek-v4-flash, qwen3-max, glm-5) instead of a single judge. We found a bug that silently recorded an errored juror as a TIE, then re-judged every affected battle, so all 1,553 are now full 3-judge verdicts.

What changed

  • Every pairwise battle is now a 3-judge majority vote (position-debiased), not a single judge; all 1,553 battles have all three jurors voting and 0 judge errors.
  • Jury tie rate fell from 50.6% (single judge, mostly position-lock) to 16.9%; 83.1% of battles are now decisive.
  • Per-judge decisiveness is balanced (deepseek 68%, glm 61%, qwen 50%); jurors' position-locks no longer overlap, so the majority resolves them.

Bug fixed

  • An errored juror was being recorded as a TIE vote, so a mid-run provider outage had quietly turned ~1,270 battles into single-judge verdicts wearing a 3-judge label.
  • Now an errored juror is retried; a battle counts only when at least 2 jurors return a real verdict, and the board refuses to publish while any battle is below that floor.

Headline finding (now jury-backed)

  • Raw judge Elo still ranks gpt-researcher #1, but it has only ~4% reachable citations, so the truth-gated headline ranks it 9th.
  • camel-ai (60% reachable, 50% quote-verified) leads the truth-gated board.

  • 48 competent-vs-competent pairs (deerflow, camel-ai, smolagents, ii-researcher, flowsearcher-ds), one per task across 48 diverse tasks, balanced agent coverage.
  • These are the hard ranking calls (close pairs); fabricator-vs-competent calls are objective and covered by the deterministic grounding gate.
  • Annotate in the browser, then Export the JSONL; the labels feed scripts/compute_judge_human_kappa.py.
v3-2026-06-03b

Eval-set remediation: cleaned goldens + per-task source allow-list

2026-06-03
scoringeval-setgrounding

Re-audited every auto-built must-cite URL for genuine topical relevance and defined a cleaned canonical benchmark: off-topic keyword-collision cites are dropped, each task is scored only on the sources that have real on-topic content, and 25 tasks with no cross-site coverage are quarantined.

What changed

  • 62% of auto-built must-cite cites were off-topic token collisions (e.g. the coffee task pulled forum threads beans-or-no-beans-in-chili and magic-bean-water); these are removed in data/golden/deep_clean.
  • Scorer now reads the cleaned goldens and applies a per-task valid_sources allow-list; forum-invalid tasks score shopping+wiki only, so a system is not penalized for forum content that is genuinely absent for the topic.
  • Canonical clean benchmark is 75 scorable tasks (65 valid + 10 forum-invalid); 25 mostly-off-topic tasks are quarantined from scoring.

Why it is fairer

  • Cleaning raises honest agents' grounding because they are now credited for citing genuinely relevant sources instead of measured against a top-K of keyword-collision junk.
  • Root cause is corpus coverage (the forum corpus is tech-heavy), not the goldens; seeding non-tech forum content to promote quarantined tasks back is logged as future work.
v3-2026-06-03

Human annotation page (/annotate)

2026-06-03
frontendeval-validityannotation

Added an in-site annotation page so humans can compare two agent reports per task and record a preference, producing labels to validate the judge against human kappa.

What

  • New /annotate page in the existing design system: two reports side by side, pick winner (A/Tie/B), cite reason dimensions, optional note + annotator id.
  • Progress + labels persist in localStorage; export labels as JSONL in the data/human_prefs schema.
  • 30 starter pairs across the headphones/electronics task family (corpus-covered).
v3-2026-06-02b

Eval validity fixes: judge window, curated golden, invalid-run exclusion

2026-06-02
scoringeval-validitygrounding

Fixed three measurement bugs found by a forensic audit, then re-scored: the pairwise judge no longer truncates long reports' conclusions, must-cite recall is scored against a curated key set instead of the whole crawl, and runner capture-failures are excluded instead of scored as real low scores.

Fixes

  • Pairwise judge window raised 5000 to 12000 chars with head+conclusion truncation, so a long report's synthesis is visible to the ranking judge.
  • must-cite recall now scored against a curated top-12 key golden set (by weight/reviews), not the whole ~121-URL crawl that was structurally unreachable (old ceiling 0.28 vs a 0.45 gate).
  • Capture failures (empty/error/traceback reports, e.g. storm stubs) are excluded as invalid runs, not scored as a real low score.
  • Wikipedia /wiki/ citations are retried in canonical /content/ form before being judged unreachable.

Result after re-score

  • Ranked (grounded): claude-code, camel-ai. Excluded: gpt-researcher and langchain-odr (fabricated/unresolvable citations), smolagents (borderline 0.29 grounding), opencode (no real data); storm runs were all invalid capture stubs.
  • Judge alignment re-validated on full reports: synthetic-gold discrimination 0.906, LLMBar agreement 0.817.
v3-2026-06-02

Real grounding-gated scoring (synthetic leaderboard removed)

2026-06-02
scoringleaderboardfairnessgrounding

Replaced the placeholder leaderboard with real scores under a simpler, harder-to-game scheme: grounding and quality are scored separately, fluent-but-ungrounded and fabricated reports are gated out, and citation volume no longer inflates rank.

Why

  • The previous public top ranks were synthetic placeholder data, not measured scores.
  • The real composite rewarded reachable-citation volume over grounding in the required facts, inflating long, heavily-cited reports.

What changed

  • Grounding = F1 of citation precision (with proof-of-fetch) and must-cite recall; the volume terms (domain balance, cited-count gate) were removed.
  • Quality = length-controlled pairwise win-rate vs peers, Bradley-Terry Elo, judged cross-family by DeepSeek with position-swap.
  • Truth-gate: a report must clear a grounding floor to be ranked; ungrounded or fabricated reports are excluded with a stated reason.
  • Removed the hardcoded synthetic fallback that fabricated the top ranks.

Method basis

  • Aligned with DeepResearch Bench (RACE and FACT), Arena-Hard, and ALCE: separate grounding from quality, and never reward verbosity or volume.
v3-2026-05-21

V3 Scoring Overhaul

2026-05-21
scoringleaderboardsandboxfrontend

Replaced the 3-dimension heuristic composite with a 6-dimension quality vector and a soft-floor truth gate, added 20 adversarial tasks to pull the top of the leaderboard apart, hardened the closed-book sandbox, and surfaced real per-pillar data on the site.

Scoring

  • New composite: composite_v3 = (0.5 + 0.5 × quote_match) × Σ w_d · score_d across 6 quality dims (coverage, depth, rigor, style, checklist, spec).
  • Soft-floor replaces the hard multiplicative gate, so broken citations no longer zero out an entire report, but quote_match still scales the result.
  • Three new LLM-judge verifiers (depth, rigor, style), each 5-point rubric with self-consistency (3× temp 0.3, median), CoT disabled.
  • New ArenaEvaluator (src/eval/evaluator.py) exposes a callable reward function for downstream RL training loops.

Separability

  • Current leaderboard separability measured at 62.86%, 2.14 pp below the 65% intermediate target.
  • 20 adversarial tasks generated across 3 families (causal/debunking, synthesis-under-contradiction, long-tail recall) to stress the new dims.
  • Top-pair densification (--strategy top-pair-densify) added to the battle runner; n=20 per top pair drops CI half-width from ~70 to ~25 Elo.

Sandbox

  • New --strict-sandbox flag enforces the closed-book contract at three layers: per-adapter tool allowlist, shim-level 403 gate on non-localhost URLs, and post-run domain audit.
  • Closed the ClaudeCode Bash-curl gap by replacing the disallowlist with --allowed-tools Bash(curl http://localhost*).
  • OpenCode now ships a per-run opencode.json with commands.allowed rather than relying on a soft prompt.
  • 8 runners are strict-eligible end-to-end; 9 others remain best-effort via the shim and audit layers.

Human alignment

  • Pairwise A/B preference collector lives at tools/human_pref_collector/ (vanilla HTML + 50-LOC stdlib server, keyboard shortcuts a/s/d).
  • Bradley-Terry weight fit via softmax reparameterization + L-BFGS-B (16 restarts); 5-fold CV refuses to publish weights worse than uniform baseline.
  • Targets Spearman ≥ 0.85 with humans on composite ranking once ≥ 200 preferences land.

Site

  • Replaced the synthetic 7-bar sparkline with a real 8-dimension per-pillar sparkline (depth, rigor, style, coverage, checklist, spec, reachability, quote_match) with hover tooltips.
  • New Quality Profile card on each agent's detail page.
  • New “Deepest reports” highlight tile on the homepage.
  • Dry-run banner renders when the leaderboard data is synthetic so visitors are not misled by placeholder numbers.
  • Adjacent-pair statistical significance now marked with an asterisk on the leaderboard.
